description: Capture, enrich, import revision-bound editorial evidence, inspect, or clear a durable local Premiere project-context index. Capture stores bounded active-sequence/source metadata; local enrichment and evidence import add caller-approved transcripts, speaker labels, shots, audio observations, notes, or opaque frame references without re-analyzing media. Never include secrets or unrelated customer data.

action.description: Capture active context, enrich it, import revision-bound editorial evidence, inspect status, or clear one local project index.

evidence.description: For import_evidence, up to 512 caller-approved records with strict source/timeline revision guards. The server does not read referenced frame files, invoke analysis, or contact a provider.

end_seconds.description: Optional end in seconds at or after start_seconds.

frame_reference_id.description: For frame_reference, an opaque fixture or review-frame identifier, never a native file path or URL.

id.description: Optional stable evidence ID for deterministic replacement.

metadata.description: Optional small scalar metadata. Credential-like and path-like keys are discarded before local storage.

name.description: Optional bounded display name for the local evidence record.

sequence_id.description: Optional captured sequence ID. Requires the exact current timeline_revision.

source_id.description: Optional captured source ID. Requires the exact current source_revision.

source_revision.description: Required exact source revision whenever source_id is supplied.

speaker_label.description: For transcript_passage or speaker_label, an editor-supplied speaker label. It is not inferred by this server.

start_seconds.description: Optional non-negative source or sequence start in seconds.

text.description: Caller-approved local evidence text. Required except for speaker_label and frame_reference, which can derive a bounded local note.

timeline_item_id.description: Optional captured timeline item ID. Requires the exact current timeline_revision.

timeline_revision.description: Required exact timeline revision whenever sequence_id or timeline_item_id is supplied.

track_index.description: Optional recorded track index when the evidence is tied to a timeline item.

track_type.description: Optional recorded track type when the evidence is tied to a timeline item.

type.description: Evidence shape: transcript passage, speaker label, shot log, audio observation, operator note, or an opaque frame reference.

project_id.description: Project context ID returned by capture; optional for status to list projects

records.description: For enrich, up to 512 transcript, shot, audio, or note records

id.description: Optional stable enrichment ID for deterministic replacement

metadata.description: Small scalar metadata object; path and credential-like keys are discarded

source_revision.description: Optional stale-analysis guard from the source record

text.description: Transcript, visual description, audio observation, or editor note

timeline_revision.description: Optional stale-placement guard from context status

replace.description: For enrich, replace prior enrichments while retaining captured core records

name: manage_project_context

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Manage Project Context
